name: postprocessing
role: pmndrs effects pipeline for Three.js: merged passes for bloom, DOF, SMAA, SSAO
summary: Effect library for Three.js that wraps its own EffectComposer and merges Effect instances into single fullscreen passes. Covers bloom, depth of field, SMAA, SSAO, god rays, LUT, chromatic aberration and more. Driven by calling composer.render at each seek. Distinguishing strength: efficient pass merging and a wide, maintained effect set.
use_when: Over Three.js examples/jsm passes for bloom, DOF and colour grading in merged passes
Film-look finishing on a Three.js shot: vignette, noise, LUT, chromatic aberration
avoid_when: WebGPU renderer with TSL nodes: Three.js built-in node post processing
Effects over 2D layers: PixiJS Filters or the compositor
Effects needing frame history: not seek-safe, check each effect

evidence.result: 90 distinct 1280x720 frames at 30 fps; all shuffled hashes equal sequential; frame 30 alpha min 0 max 255. postprocessing 6.39.6 with three 0.186.1, Playwright 1.64.1, Chromium 156.0.8078.4, Node 22.19.0; screenshot route. Contact sheet inspected. Alpha min 0 reached only after scene tuning (emissive lowered); a brighter bloom left a faint alpha 2-4 haze.
evidence.scope: Bloom+ChromaticAberration EffectPass over three.js (Vignette set, not visibly confirmed); composer.render(0) per seek; deterministic; alpha 0-255 on a tuned scene; no Noise/Glitch; macOS arm64.

notes: 2026-10-26: compatibility with Three.js 0.186 was not verified; the library targets WebGLRenderer, not the WebGPU renderer.

assessment.rationale: pmndrs maintained, release Sep 2026; Zlib licence. Merges effects into fewer passes than the Three.js examples composer.
